story.headline: Llama 4 Maverick tops an independent open-weight coding benchmark
story.source_excerpt: Independent benchmarking firm Artificial Analysis placed Llama 4 Maverick at the top of its coding index this week, ahead of every other open-weight model it tested. The firm's head of research said Maverick edged out the prior open-weight leader by four points.
implications: Re-test your coding-agent prompts against Llama 4 Maverick
Factor open-weight gains into the next build-vs-buy review

story.headline: Analyst report: enterprise LLM spend tripled in a year
story.source_excerpt: A report from Andreessen Horowitz found enterprise spending on large language models grew threefold over the past year, with inference now the single largest line item. The firm surveyed 60 enterprises and said budgets are shifting from experimentation to production.
implications: Re-baseline your feature's inference budget for the next planning cycle
Watch for procurement pressure to consolidate model vendors
story.summary: An Andreessen Horowitz report found enterprise LLM spending grew threefold year over year, with inference the single largest cost line.

implications: Evaluate MCP for your tool-integration layer if you haven't

story.headline: NIST adds prompt-injection tests to its public AI eval suite
story.source_excerpt: The National Institute of Standards and Technology said it added prompt-injection resistance tests to its public AI evaluation suite, available to developers at no cost. A NIST program lead said the tests were validated against 12 commercial models before release.
implications: Fold the NIST injection tests into your pre-release eval gate
Use a recognized suite to anchor security claims with buyers

story.headline: EU confirms AI Act high-risk rules take effect August 2027
story.source_excerpt: The European Commission confirmed that obligations for high-risk AI systems, including logging and human oversight, take effect in August 2027. A Commission spokesperson said no further delays are planned.
implications: Classify which of your features fall under high-risk now
Budget logging and human-oversight work into the 2027 roadmap
story.summary: The European Commission confirmed AI Act high-risk obligations — logging and human oversight — take effect in August 2027.

story.headline: AI note-taking apps cross 500M downloads, data firm says
story.source_excerpt: According to Sensor Tower, consumer AI note-taking apps surpassed 500 million cumulative downloads in the first quarter of 2026. The firm said the category grew faster than any other productivity segment it tracks.
implications: Study the onboarding flows behind these note-taking numbers
Watch for platform bundling to compress standalone demand
story.summary: Sensor Tower data shows consumer AI note-taking apps surpassed 500 million cumulative downloads in Q1 2026.
